title: Combined Pre-K and Wraparound Tuition Cap
content:
**Cap.** Under the combined Pre-K and wraparound tuition cap of Student Enrollment, Transfers and Pre-Kindergarten Admissions, when the month's Pre-K tuition charge and the family's Creek Kids Club Extended Day Program charge for the Pre-K Wraparound seat for the same billing month together exceed 650.00, the excess over 650.00 is added to the combined-program credit. Otherwise nothing is added.

The family's Creek Kids Club charge for the seat is figured by how the seat is paid:

| Seat | Family's Creek Kids Club charge for the billing month |
|---|---|
| funded by Workforce Solutions Child Care Services | the Creek Kids Club tuition charged to that seat for the billing month, less the Workforce Solutions remittances posted for that seat for the billing month |
| family-paid | the Creek Kids Club tuition charged to that seat for the billing month alone |

The billing month is the Pre-K enrollment's most recent billing month.

## Worked cases (hypothetical amounts)

| Pre-K tuition charge | Seat tuition for the month | Workforce Solutions remittances for the month | Family's charge | Combined | Added |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 420.00 | 300.00 | none (family-paid) | 300.00 | 720.00 | 70.00 |
| 420.00 | 300.00 | 260.00 (funded seat) | 40.00 | 460.00 | nothing |
| 420.00 | 230.00 | none (family-paid) | 230.00 | 650.00 | nothing: exactly 650.00 does not exceed it |
| 420.00 | 230.01 | none (family-paid) | 230.01 | 650.01 | 0.01 |
